PDF Gpu-based Volume Ray-casting Supporting Specular Reflection and Refraction
The proposed technique modifies GPU-based ray- casting by processing a ray-caster multiple times with different entry and exit points. Thus, we are able to use arbitrary ray-caster modules, potentially supporting different rendering styles, by just transforming their input points.
